text:
Type: white wooden slat plant pot
Use: holding a potted plant on the floor, a table or a shelf; living room, bedroom, kitchen
Style: farmhouse, rustic, Scandinavian
Materials: thin wooden veneer strips in a white painted finish, riveted bands
Colors: white, pale natural wood inside
Shape: round tapering bucket made of vertical slats held by two horizontal bands, a bushel basket look, medium sized, light visual weight
Feel: fresh, rustic, casual, bright
Goes with: green plants, light wood, linen, white walls; farmhouse, cottage or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: KALASA
product.description: A plastic inner pot makes the plant pot waterproof.
